summary: This bill directs the Environmental Protection Agency to study and publish guidance on how certain facilities should calculate and report their indirect greenhouse gas emissions from their supply chains and product use.

scores.thoughts: This bill directs the EPA to study and publish guidance on calculating and reporting 'scope 3 emissions,' which are indirect greenhouse gas emissions. This aims to improve the measurement and understanding of a broader range of emissions, which is a step towards more comprehensive environmental protection related to climate change. The bill is entirely focused on this topic.
